children.value: Frequently Asked Questions
How long do Smok TFOS pods last?
Most vapers get
one to two weeks

from a Smok TFOS pod. Sweet or dark e-liquids, chain vaping and Boost mode all shorten that. Change the pod when flavour fades, the draw tastes burnt or it gurgles after a refill, because the mesh coil is built in and cannot be swapped on its own.
Can you refill Smok TFOS pods?
Yes. Smok TFOS pods are
refillable, not prefilled

. Pull back the rubber stopper on the side of the pod, fill with 50/50 e-liquid to just below the top, and push the stopper closed. Each pod takes 2ml and can be refilled many times until the built-in mesh coil loses flavour.
Do Smok TFOS pods fit any other vape?
No.
Smok TFOS pods fit the Smok TFOS Vape Pod Kit only

. Smok names each pod after its device series, so Novo, Nord, Solus, RPM and Acro pods are different shapes and will not seat in the kit, and a Smok TFOS pod will not seat in those devices. Check the pod name before buying.
Which Smok TFOS pod is best, 0.8ohm or 0.6ohm?
The
Smok TFOS 0.8ohm mesh pod

is best for most people: a tight MTL draw that suits 10mg or 20mg nic salts and gives the longest battery life in Norm mode. Choose the 0.6ohm mesh pod if you want a warmer, airier RDL draw with more vapour from 50/50 freebase e-liquid in Boost mode.
How many pods come in a pack of Smok TFOS pods?
Each pack holds
2 Smok TFOS pods in one resistance

, either 0.8ohm mesh or 0.6ohm mesh, with the coil already built into each pod. Nothing else is needed: fill a pod with e-liquid, let it stand for five minutes, and click it onto the Smok TFOS Vape Pod Kit magnetically.
Why does my Smok TFOS pod taste burnt?
A burnt taste usually means the mesh ran dry.
Prime every new Smok TFOS pod for five minutes

after filling, keep the e-liquid above the bottom of the window, avoid chain vaping in Boost mode, and stick to 50/50 blends rather than thick shortfills. If the taste stays after a refill, the pod is finished.
